heroDescription: What started as showing friends around Chow Kit market has become 15 years of sharing the real Malaysia, one meal at a time.

founderSection.heading: She Started by Taking Friends to the Market
paragraphs: Growing up in Malaysia, I spent countless mornings walking through wet markets with my mom. While she haggled for the freshest fish and picked out vegetables, I watched the hawkers craft dishes that had been passed down through generations. The sizzle of char kway teow on a screaming hot wok, the aromatic clouds of curry rising from street stalls, the careful art of folding roti canai. This was my Malaysia.

When I started bringing friends from other countries around, I realised they were missing this entire world. They'd eat at air-conditioned restaurants with picture menus, never knowing that just two streets away, a grandmother was making laksa the same way her mother taught her 60 years ago.

Simply Enak started in 2011 because I wanted to share what I experienced as a child. Not the Malaysia you see in guidebooks, but the one I know: the night markets, the family recipes, the vendors who remember your face and your favourite dish. The real Malaysia that tourists walk past every day.

timelineSection.heading: 15 Years of Simply Enak
timelineSection.description: From a first food walk through Chow Kit to features in National Geographic, BBC, and Lonely Planet. This is our story.

milestones.title: 5,000+ guests and still eating
milestones.description: Every week, guests from 50+ countries join us at the same stalls we've eaten at for 15 years. The guides know the vendors by name. The vendors know us.

milestones.title: Destination Eat Drink Podcast
milestones.description: Pauline joins the Destination Eat Drink podcast to talk about Penang's food culture - Nyonya cooking, nasi kandar, and what makes Malaysian street food unique.

milestones.title: The Edge TV
milestones.description: Malaysian business news channel The Edge TV profiles Simply Enak - Pauline takes the crew through the food stalls that tell KL's story, neighbourhood by neighbourhood.

milestones.title: The Food Ranger - 3 Videos
milestones.description: Trevor James (The Food Ranger, 6M+ subscribers) films three videos with our team across KL's hawker stalls. Together they rack up millions of views, putting Malaysian street food on the global food map.

milestones.title: Getaway, Channel Nine Australia
milestones.description: Australian travel show Getaway flies host David Reyne to KL. Pauline takes the crew through Chow Kit wet market and Jalan Alor for primetime Australian television.

milestones.title: TVNZ: Karena & Kasey's Foreign Flavours
milestones.description: Karena and Kasey Bird (MasterChef Australia winners) bring their TVNZ cooking series to Penang - Simply Enak shows them the Georgetown food scene that locals eat at every day.

milestones.title: TLC: Taste Off with Chef Aaron Craze
milestones.description: British chef Aaron Craze brings TLC's 'Taste Off' to KL. Pauline takes the crew through the hawker stalls and morning markets that make Malaysian food famous.

milestones.title: Time Out Penang
milestones.description: Time Out names Simply Enak one of Penang's essential experiences, putting us on the map for food travellers heading north.

milestones.title: BBC Journalists
milestones.description: A team of BBC journalists join our Penang food trail to film a documentary with our guide Mark. The resulting video lives on the Simply Enak YouTube channel.

milestones.title: National Geographic: Confucius Was a Foodie
milestones.description: NatGeo's 'Confucius Was a Foodie' series films Season 3 with Pauline guiding the crew through Kuala Lumpur's Chinese culinary heritage. Our vendor relationships open doors cameras usually don't get through.

milestones.title: KL Food Trails - City Hall & Time Out KL
milestones.description: Partnered with Kuala Lumpur City Hall's Tourism Unit and Time Out KL to map four neighbourhoods: Jalan Alor, Kampung Baru, Old KL, and Pudu. A printed map guiding visitors to the stalls and kopitiam that anchor each area.

milestones.title: Le Guide du Routard
milestones.description: France's most-read travel guide lists Simply Enak among Malaysia's top food experiences - our first major international press recognition.

milestones.title: Lonely Planet
milestones.description: A Lonely Planet researcher joins one of our Petaling Street tours - incognito, as they always are. Simply Enak makes it into the most-read travel guide in the world.

milestones.title: Simply Enak Founded
milestones.description: Pauline leads her first food walk through Chow Kit market with a small group of friends. Nobody calls it a tour yet - it's just lunch.

philosophySection.heading: Three Things We Won't Compromise On

items.title: Unscripted & Human
items.description: We don't do canned jokes or rehearsed speeches. Our guides are licensed professionals, but they talk to you like friends: sharing real stories, not scripts.

items.title: Slow Travel
items.description: We walk. We pause. We take the time to appreciate the details: the architecture, the smells, the sounds of the neighbourhood.

items.title: Support Local
items.description: We exclusively visit family-run businesses. Your tour fee directly supports the heritage keepers of our food culture.

teamSection.heading: The People Behind the Flavours
teamSection.description: We're a small team, all licensed with Tourism Malaysia. We grew up eating at these same stalls.
